A '''data-sifter filter''' was a type of [[Computer/Legends|computing]] technology. [[Memory droid]]s had [[Memory bank/Legends|memory cores]] that contained multiple [[Kraren XI Superprocessor]]s and data-sifter filters.<ref name="EGTD" />
